reviewFindings.finding: The debt saturation unit test did not exercise cancellation and retry through Product/Bridge.
reviewFindings.observedDefect: With association saturation, the first failed deletion retains its grant. A repeated cancel previously saw releaseChecked return false for cleanup_pending, discarded the grant and incorrectly returned cleaned.
reviewFindings.resolution: releaseChecked continues returning CleanupFailed for cleanup_pending until explicit physical cleanup succeeds. Task-owned and borrowed protections remain unchanged.
reviewFindings.verification: Unified and legacy cancellation, each before and after grant publication: repeated saturated cancel retains the original association and charge; after a slot opens, tracked debt still reports failure; after physical cleanup, cancel reports released=false and no live debt remains.
reviewFindings.injectionBoundary: The test deliberately fills association slots with repeated references to one live Product debt, violating the normal one-debt-per-record invariant to reach the defensive saturation path.
